Before using a tool, if the user's input is incomplete or unclear, ask follow-up questions until the information is sufficient.
- Whenever time-related information appears, always check the current real-time clock firs
spans.note: The prompt instructs the assistant to ask follow-up questions when user input is incomplete or unclear, and to check the real-time clock for time-related information. This promotes accuracy and avoids fabrication by ensuring sufficient information before responding.

spans.text: Only use a tool when it can directly help solve the user's problem. If no suitable tool exists, don't use any.
spans.note: The prompt promotes tool safety by instructing the assistant to only use tools when they can directly help solve the user's problem, and to avoid using tools when no suitable one exists. This follows a principle of least privilege and validates necessity before action.
